question: Do 128 native ngram gather readers improve whole-request latency versus explicit 64 on this frozen natural 16K workload?

method.phase_rate_aggregation: sum native tokens / sum native API seconds; arithmetic means separately retained

interpretation: This bracket does not establish a stable whole-request gain for 128 readers over 64.
limitations: One prompt and three sequential measurements per window; no significance claim.
The 32K comparison does not itself establish speed at the final 262K serving capacity.
Native API phases are unqualified observations; complete JSON body arrival is not TTFT.
